catalogRegistration.role: coordinate-registration audit; photograph owns visible stars

pointSourcePresentation.positionSource: licensed ESO photographic local maxima; no Google catalogue bytes
pointSourcePresentation.qualification: native fixed-size catalogue behavior collapsed into the prepared cubemap; point positions and colors remain ESO-derived

sky.qualification: source-photographed full sky; orientation is registered to Galactic coordinates but no observer epoch or Neptune ephemeris is claimed; no Sun is baked into the cubemap

analyticRadialFit.qualification: Least-squares fit to annular red-channel means from the bound native 128 by 128 Sun texture; fitted values only, no source pixels.

distanceScaling.qualification: The opaque photospheric core is projected from the IAU nominal solar radius and the object catalog's mean heliocentric distance. The retained glow profile remains a visual presentation; the distance is not epoch-specific.

provenance.source: Google Earth Pro Mars native Sun contract-derived visual standard
provenance.qualification: Mars-derived clean-room Sun appearance and camera-relative motion are shared as a cssEarth presentation standard; no per-object native Sun position or ephemeris is claimed.

controls.label: Visible color
controls.description: Color-adjusted Hubble OPAL composite from 2025, with approximate visible-color calibration. North of about 30° N, missing observations are continued from the boundary and faded to a uniform pole; that cap is illustrative.
controls.title: OPAL visible-color map
controls.summary: Colors approximate visible cloud patterns. North of about 30° N, an illustrative cap replaces missing observations.

controls.label: Methane
controls.description: Hubble OPAL 619 nm reflectance from 2025, in false color. North of about 30° N, boundary continuation supplies an illustrative cap, not measured spectral coverage.
controls.title: OPAL FQ619N map
controls.summary: False colors show 619 nm reflectance. North of about 30° N, missing coverage is filled from its boundary, not measured.

controls.label: Near infrared
controls.description: Hubble OPAL 845 nm reflectance from 2025, in false color. North of about 30° N, boundary continuation supplies an illustrative cap, not measured spectral coverage.
controls.title: OPAL F845M map
controls.summary: False colors show 845 nm reflectance. North of about 30° N, missing coverage is filled from its boundary, not measured.
